description:
Based on Aihara Hiroyuki and Adachi Nami's Usagi-chan to Yukidaruma (うさぎちゃんとゆきだるま) picture book.

The main character is a little girl rabbit called Anzu, who lives in a lush green forest. She just loves playing in the forests and meadows.

Note: Participated in 2016's MIFA (Marche international du film d'animation) animation market, which is run by and concurrently with the Annecy International Animation Film Festival.
